title: Waste of wool or of fine or coarse animal hair

review.classification: Current CPC 3.0 lists waste of wool or of fine or coarse animal hair in 39212. The sold or supplied goods are identifiable, non-garnetted hard waste consisting of spun-yarn offcuts. Noils are separately identified at 26140 and garnetted stock at 39213. Incidental other fibre, conforming yarn and recycled fibre cannot stand in for this reference output.
review.primary_evidence: The Woolmark guide describes yarn preparation, winding and fault clearing. The Natural Fibre Company separately lists hard spun-yarn pieces and noils. The UNIDO report distinguishes spun hard waste before subsequent reopening. A Massey field study reports receipt of actual mill hard yarn waste, identifies pure wool among several mill compositions, and records automatic winding fault removal. These are distinct evidence sources. They support the physical boundary without establishing the species, treatment, acceptance or mass of a particular industrial study lot.
review.measurement: The bilingual methods carry net first release Q, the full winding and sorting inventory, rejected lots, associated stock, later transfers and reversals. Packaging is reconciled per distinct article through purchases, external non-purchase first receipt and same-article returns, with real burden and gross stock retained. Metered energy is separate from an electricity supplier flow; identified mass and volume have separate measurement bases.
review.readiness: 36 inventory cards in each language. The manifest identifies all 35 presently unbound rows. The specific cut product has no verified native flow ID. The one retained elementary-flow identity is water vapour released to unspecified air, using a mass reference. The independent target check performed 183 checks, skipped zero, and retained 24 missing-range warnings. Scientific review, formal translation review, and publication remain pending. Site, buyer and provider data are still required for a study.
review.native_version: Mass links to Units of mass and volume links to Units of volume. The native Energy property points to the Units of energy UUID at version 01.00.000; the archived group is 03.00.003. It supplies the physical MJ/kWh conversion, without establishing equivalence of versions or an electricity provider. An unrelated Massey research repository bitstream identifier is a source locator.

sources.role: Woolmark post-spinning operations module. Winding, fault clearing and preparation are physical process evidence.
First-party mill account distinguishes hard spun-yarn pieces from separate waste forms.
UNIDO report ID/33, printed p. 29, paragraphs 81–85. Technical historical context for hard waste before garnetting.
Independent Massey University investigator received mill fibre and yarn and documented the hard/soft distinction and automatic fault removal. See printed pp. 14, 35 and 37.
Native ILCD originals verified by UUID and file digest. Product identity and specific supplier coverage require separate evidence.
